note: 203 mm howitzer M1931 (B-4) in firing position, a four-view with the tube level and a scale bar in metres. The bar reads 58.7 px/m, at which the barrel is 4.86 m against the published 5.087 and the height 2.39 m against 2.5; at 56.0 both agree and the width over the tracks is 2.6 m against 2.7, so every view is read at 56.0. The pin is the pivot the top carriage turns on, on the ground under the middle of the track units.
